justifications.r1: Mono-black big mana (Cabal Coffers, Urborg, Crypt Ghast, Nykthos, Dark Ritual).
justifications.r2: Skullclamp, Idol of Oblivion, Yawgmoth, and Staff of Domination provide continuous replenishment.
justifications.a1: High density of instant-speed repeatable crime enablers (10+ permanents).
justifications.a2: Deploys Gisa and triggers crimes on every player's turn starting Turn 5.
justifications.p1: Presents menace Zombie army (up to 8 Zombies / 24 power per turn cycle) on Turns 6–7.
justifications.p2: 1–2 opponent untap steps to swing for lethal with menace swarm, or Gray Merchant drain.
justifications.p3: Crimes trigger at instant speed; menace makes combat difficult to block.
justifications.i1: Targeted exile crimes and instant removal.
justifications.i2: Repeatable graveyard exile (Ghost Vacuum, Relic, Withered Wretch) and Noxious Ghoul board wipes.
justifications.s1: Inherent Ward: {2}, Pay 2 life, plus Commander's Plate (protection from WURG).
justifications.s2: Bringer of the Last Gift and mass reanimation rebuild full boards.
justifications.s3: Crime engines can trigger independently, but Zombies require Gisa.
